 Local Priority Health offers tips for Medicare Open Enrollment
 Enrollment opens Oct. 15
 Bill Froehlich , Megan Huiskens 10-17-2026 at 05:40:21 PM EDT Link Copied! TRAVERSE CITY — Open enrollment for Medicare insurance plans starts nationwide on October 15th. The federal health insurance program is aimed mostly at those ages 65 and over. 
 With so may plans to choose from, and many plan options from previous years disappearing, we invited Priority Health to join us on Good Day. Medicare Specialist Emily Martens offers some guidance for viewers. 
 You can learn more about Medicare plans here . 
 Advertisement In Michigan, MDHHS encouraged residents who need help navigating Medicare plans to contact MI Options, which offers free counseling from certified counselors.
 Residents can call 800-803-7174 to schedule an appointment.
